entry_before.title_en: Meta-attractors and reproduction of selection conditions
entry_before.claim_zh: 活动后果参与重建选择该组织的条件，使其经具体承载者变化仍能接续；区分机制条件、实际边界、动力学接近及可行纠正。 新会话进一步检验精确局部目标执行怎样经制度后果进入共同损失；局部安全与共同执行保护分列。
entry_before.claim_en: Consequences help reproduce conditions selecting an organization across carrier changes; distinguish mechanism conditions, formed boundaries, dynamical approach and feasible correction. A new session tests how exact local objective fidelity can lead through institutional consequences to collective loss; local safety and joint-execution protection remain distinct.
entry_before.scope_zh: 原47项 Lean 定理／65项审计保留；新40项定理／69项审计（另54项继承审计）接通不同产出承载者、材料、实际探测、修复及后续核心轨迹。1,681项市场及1,053项回返预算计算保留。正确识别不保证还能回应，等待也可能改善可恢复探测。理论探索已到被动历史不足以辨认回返来源的边界；经验对应仍须在具体应用中检验，无普遍预警分数或独立验收主张。 集体破坏第一构造另有32项新定理／41项审计，检查两位置阶段最优化、正且可增长吞吐下的有限到达、精确盆地及严格保护；平局失败与无法自动恢复保留。接续新增71项定理／100项审计，接通有限人口替换、内部筹资、恢复／耗尽精确分界及材料约束下的核心接续；恢复前归零、分流与缺件失败保留。到墙范围是实际征收、证据、权限与承诺的形成和维护，未宣称普遍收敛或经验对应。
entry_before.scope_en: The first 47 Lean theorems / 65 audits are preserved; 40 new theorems / 69 new audits, with 54 inherited audits separate, connect varied carrier yields, material, executed probing, repair and subsequent core traces. The 1,681 market and 1,053 recurrence-budget calculations retain their scope. Correct identification need not preserve response capacity; waiting can enable recoverable probing. The theoretical exploration reaches a passive-identification limit. Field correspondence remains application-specific; no universal warning score or independent acceptance is claimed. A separate first collective-destruction construction adds 32 theorems / 41 audits for two-position stage optimization, finite arrival under positive and possibly growing throughput, an exact basin and strict protection, retaining tie failure and absent automatic recovery. The continuation adds 71 theorems / 100 audits for bounded population replacement, internally financed correction, exact recovery/destruction boundaries and material-guarded core histories. Interim loss, diversion and missing-parts failures remain. The wall is formation and preservation of actual collection, evidence, authority and commitments; universal convergence and empirical correspondence are not established.

entry.scope_zh: 原47项定理／65项审计及承载者识别40项／69项保留。新58项 Lean 定理／107项审计由回返量推导维护，接通实际建立、相位、耦合、规则修订及操作条件可再生的准入；短期材料最优化与授权薄弱时的失败保留。1,024项网络轨迹探索不冒充证明。新的理论目标继续：判准本身的形成与修订尚待连接；非独立验收，无新增经验门槛。 集体破坏第一构造另有32项新定理／41项审计，检查两位置阶段最优化、正且可增长吞吐下的有限到达、精确盆地及严格保护；平局失败与无法自动恢复保留。接续新增71项定理／100项审计，接通有限人口替换、内部筹资、恢复／耗尽精确分界及材料约束下的核心接续；恢复前归零、分流与缺件失败保留。到墙范围是实际征收、证据、权限与承诺的形成和维护，未宣称普遍收敛或经验对应。
entry.scope_en: The first 47-theorem/65-audit and carrier-diagnosis 40/69 results retain their scopes. A new 58-theorem/107-audit construction derives maintenance from return flows and joins establishment, phase, coupling, rule revision and admission with reproduced operating support. Myopic material-retention and weakened-authorization failures remain. The 1,024 network explorations are not proofs. The renewed theoretical goal stays active at formation and revision of the criterion itself; no independent acceptance or added empirical gate is claimed. A separate first collective-destruction construction adds 32 theorems / 41 audits for two-position stage optimization, finite arrival under positive and possibly growing throughput, an exact basin and strict protection, retaining tie failure and absent automatic recovery. The continuation adds 71 theorems / 100 audits for bounded population replacement, internally financed correction, exact recovery/destruction boundaries and material-guarded core histories. Interim loss, diversion and missing-parts failures remain. The wall is formation and preservation of actual collection, evidence, authority and commitments; universal convergence and empirical correspondence are not established.

Criterion formation and revision are the next connection; the parallel 71-theorem population continuation is credited, not reopened. Numerical cycle exploration remains separate from proof.

**选择与纠正的再生条件 / Reproducing selection and correction，2026-10-08。** [58项新定理／107项审计](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/META-ATTRACTOR-REPRODUCTION.md)连接相互维护、实际建立、相位与耦合、规则修订及授权角色的再生。准入可运行不等于其判准正确；更广理论研究继续。/ The earlier focused exploration remains complete at its scope; the renewed programme now studies how the criterion itself forms and changes. The parallel population replacement/funding result is reused.

**元吸引子的规则再生 / Reproduction of meta-attractor rules，2026-10-08。** [理论与反审](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/META-ATTRACTOR-REPRODUCTION.md)以58项新 Lean 定理／107项审计推导角色相互维护，并实现建立、耦合、规则修订及有条件的准入再生。/ This advances the operative conditions of selection and correction within one process. Formation and revision of the admission criterion remain open; no new ethical axiom or empirical completion gate is added.

**Meta-attractor rule reproduction / 元吸引子规则再生，2026-10-08。** [New argument and author counterreview](META-ATTRACTOR-REPRODUCTION.md): 58 checked theorems / 107 audits derive maintenance from return flows and connect establishment, phase, coupling, costed revisions and materially supported admission. The broader renewed goal remains active at criterion formation and revision; the parallel population connection is credited.
